text: David Richardson, born on 18 August 1987, is a British former competitive figure skater. He won the 2011 British national championship and claimed the title of 2013 Golden Bear of Zagreb. He qualified for the free skate at the 2012 World Junior Championships held in Ljubljana, Slovenia, where he finished in 23rd place overall. Richardson trained at the NIC Nottingham and last competed during the 2013–14 season.
